interactions.expected: Consent greeting actually plays pre-generated audio
interactions.actual: media.play() calls=1, <audio> elements=0, control label after click="English | हिंदी | Go back | Replay audio | Yes, I agree | No, do not proceed"

interactions.expected: Decline ends intake and shows no-data confirmation
interactions.actual: consent_declined screen shown: true

interactions.expected: Denied microphone shows the approved MicDenied screen (Figma 72:209) with Try microphone again
interactions.actual: Figma screen present=true, inline banner present=true, retry action present=true

interactions.expected: Visible countdown timer advances while recording
Recording stops automatically at 30 s and hands the audio to the transcript step
interactions.actual: after 32 s the transcript-confirmation screen is shown=true; body head="Patient IntakeDoctor Portal | + | Samvad HealthDesk AI | English | हिंदी | Go back | What we heard | What we heard. Tap to edit. | Send | · Confirm and send | S"

interactions.expected: Microphone control is usable again after a completed recording (multi-turn voice)
interactions.actual: mic button present=true, disabled=false, status caption="Maximum recording time: 30 seconds"

interactions.expected: Per-field edit control opens the field editor (Figma pencil icon affordance)
interactions.actual: modal=true, fullscreen overlay=true, prefilled value="Aarav Sharma"

interactions.expected: Confirm appointment creates a booking and shows confirmation with reference code
interactions.actual: clicked=true, confirmation="true", reference shown=true

interactions.expected: Not now ends booking without an appointment and keeps the report submitted
interactions.actual: report-only confirmation shown: true

interactions.expected: No-slot state: "Try another date" advances to another date / reloads slots
interactions.actual: button found=true, screen changed=true, still shows no-slot copy=false

interactions.expected: Deterministic chest-pain phrase stops intake and shows 112 guidance
interactions.actual: emergency screen=true, 112 shown=true, no slots offered=true

interactions.expected: Hindi emergency guidance renders in Devanagari (title + body + 112)
interactions.actual: title Hindi=true, 112 present=true, body still English=false

interactions.expected: “Play question again” replays the question audio
interactions.actual: media.play() calls=1, left the transcript screen=false

interactions.expected: Password field offers the Figma show/hide (eye) control
interactions.actual: password visibility buttons=1

interactions.expected: Doctor Login offers return navigation to the patient side
interactions.actual: candidate links=["Patient Intake","Back to Patient Intake"]

interactions.expected: Invalid credentials show an understandable error and keep the user on login
interactions.actual: error shown=true, still on login=true

interactions.expected: Valid demo credentials open the dashboard
interactions.actual: dashboard=true, reports list rows=6

interactions.expected: Reports tabs filter the list (All/Urgent/Booked/Not booked)
interactions.actual: row counts per tab={"All":2,"Urgent":1,"Booked":0,"Not booked":1}

interactions.expected: Reports search filters by patient/ref/concern
interactions.actual: rows before=2, after "Rohan"=1

interactions.expected: A report with possible_urgent / needs_human_review shows those warning flags
interactions.actual: screen text mentions review warning=true; warning section="Warning flags | Possible urgent (Urgent review hold) | possible_urgent | Needs human review | needs_h"

interactions.expected: Patient responses expand and come from the messages integration
interactions.actual: disclosure found=true, answered=false, error state=false, empty=false

interactions.expected: Mark Reviewed writes the review fields and reflects the new state
interactions.actual: button found=true, reviewed state shown=true

interactions.expected: Appointments table header labels match the cell contents
interactions.actual: headers=["Date","Time","Patient","Age / Gender","Concern","Status","Intake"] firstRow=["Thu, Nov 05","3:30 PM","Aarav Sharma","28 · Male","Headache for 3 days","Upcoming","View Intake →"]

interactions.expected: General Medicine doctor sees read-only cross-visibility on an Emergency report
interactions.actual: read-only shown=true, acknowledge button=false

interactions.expected: Sidebar navigation returns to dashboard and Log out ends the session
interactions.actual: dashboard reachable=true, login shown after logout=true

interactions.expected: Doctor detail back button returns to the reports list from a direct URL
interactions.actual: direct detail loaded=true, back button=true, reports list shown=true

interactions.expected: Every non-home patient screen exposes a visible back control
interactions.actual: {"welcomeBack":0,"consentBack":1,"conversationBack":1,"reviewBack":1,"bookingBack":1,"confirmBack":1,"emergencyBack":1,"heardBack":1}

interactions.expected: Buttons are keyboard-reachable with a visible focus indicator
interactions.actual: focusables=6, after 4x Tab active={"tag":"BUTTON","label":"हिंदी","outline":"solid","width":57,"height":30}
